faq.q: What is the origin of Gokhan?
faq.a: Gokhan is associated with Turkish. Gokhan is Turkish, from gök ('sky') + han ('lord'), meaning 'sky lord'.
No — the underlying form is Turkish, not Arabic.
Gokhan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Turkish-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Gokhan should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Gokhan is a Turkish compound, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.a: In Urdu, Gokhan is rendered گوک خان and carries the sense گوک خان، آسمان کا سردار.

faq.a: In Persian, Gokhan is rendered گوک‌خان and carries the sense گوک‌خان، سرور آسمان.

faq.q: What are the variants of Gokhan?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Gokhan, gokhan. Script forms are غُوكْهَان, ګوکخان, گوک خان, گوک‌خان, गोखान.
